newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria urges U.S. to pressure Israel for change.
newsitem.headline: Syria urges U.S. to pressure Israel for change.

text.p: Official Syrian newspapers on Friday accused Israel of blocking the Middle East peace process and urged Washington to pressure the Jewish state to change its policies as U.S. missions head to the region.
"The responsibility of blocking the peace process and pushing it to a chasm is totally an Israeli one," the official daily al-Thawra said.
"Confronting this dangerous policy and saving the process is the responsibility of the international society and the U.S. administration, who sponsored the process and its continuity."

U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, spurred by heightened tension following twin suicide bombings in Jerusalem and Israeli punitive measures against Palestinians, is expected to visit the region later this month.
Peace envoy Dennis Ross is due to arrive in Israel on Saturday.
"Success of Ross and Albright's tours to the region depends on putting pressure on the side who blocked the peace process..,"al-Thawra said.

Sporadic Syrian-Israeli peace talks ground to a halt when Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected handing back the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967, in return for peace with Syria. Syria wants full withdrawal.
The ruling party newspaper al-Baath urged the U.S. to be neutral in its bid to revive the peace talks.

"It is the duty of the American administration to shoulder its responsibilities fully and work very seriously and naturally to revive the peace process and put it on the right track to preserve the peace, security and stability of the region," it said.
